license_required.quote: A person may not practice dietetics or claim to be a dietitian or a dietetic technician unless that person is licensed in accordance with this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Board of Licensing of Dietetic Practice
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Board of Licensing of Dietetic Practice established under this chapter.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant must exhibit trustworthiness and competency.

degree_required.quote: must have received a baccalaureate or higher degree from an accredited college or university

accrediting_body.quote: present evidence satisfactory to the board of having successfully completed the academic requirements established by the American Dietetic Association or equivalent requirements as determined by the board

required.quote: An applicant must submit to the board evidence of having successfully completed the experience requirements approved by the American Dietetic Association or equivalent experience approved by the board.

duration.quote: That experience must include at least 6 months full-time experience in the field of dietetics, or its part-time equivalent.

kind.quote: at least 6 months full-time experience in the field of dietetics, or its part-time equivalent

exams.name: American Dietetic Association examination (dietitian)
exams.notes: Examination requirement does not apply to applicants who practiced as a dietitian without censure for 10 years prior to September 30, 1987.
exams.quote: The applicant must have successfully completed an examination given by the American Dietetic Association or its equivalent as determined and approved by the board.

exams.name: American Dietetic Association examination (dietetic technician)
exams.quote: The applicant must have successfully completed an examination given by the American Dietetic Association or its equivalent as determined by the board.

interval_years.quote: A license expires annually on September 30th or such other time as the commissioner may designate.

required.quote: Each license renewal must be accompanied by evidence of continuing education or other requirements as established in rule by the board.

available.quote: The board may, in its discretion, grant a license under this chapter to an individual licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established by this chapter.

requirements.value: Board must determine that the other state's requirements or standards are equivalent to or greater than Maine's. The board may not impose more stringent requirements on out-of-state applicants than on in-state applicants.
requirements.quote: The board may not require an individual licensed in another state to meet requirements or standards for licensure in the State that are more stringent than requirements or standards for licensure imposed on in-state applicants.

exists.quote: "Board" means the Board of Licensing of Dietetic Practice established under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may deny, refuse to renew, or impose disciplinary sanctions for reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5-A, paragraph A.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may deny a license, refuse to renew a license or impose the disciplinary sanctions authorized by Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A for any of the reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A, paragraph A.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: 32 §9910. Denial or refusal to renew license; disciplinary action

definition_quote.value: Dietetics means the professional discipline of assessing the nutritional needs of an individual, including recognition of the effects of the individual's physical condition and economic circumstances, and the applying of scientific principles of nutrition to prescribing means to ensure the individual's proper nourishment and care.
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics" means the professional discipline of assessing the nutritional needs of an individual, including recognition of the effects of the individual's physical condition and economic circumstances, and the applying of scientific principles of nutrition to prescribing means to ensure the individual's proper nourishment and care.

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person who practices dietetics and who is licensed as a dietitian under this chapter. ... "Licensed dietetic technician" means a person licensed under this chapter who practices dietetics under the supervision of a dietitian who is licensed in accordance with this chapter.

provisional_license_available.quote: The board shall adopt rules establishing requirements for a temporary license within the scope of this chapter.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: "Licensed dietetic technician" means a person licensed under this chapter who practices dietetics under the supervision of a dietitian who is licensed in accordance with this chapter.

value: Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association (for weight control program exemption)
alternative_credential_pathways.quote: A dietitian in another state without licensing who is registered by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association or its successor or other organization approved by the board.

telehealth_practice_authorized.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license, in accordance with any requirements and restrictions imposed by this section and in accordance with standards of practice.

value: Any person licensed or registered in this State under any other law
Individuals who give general nutrition-related information
State and federal employees in cooperative extension food and nutrition programs and supplemental food and nutrition programs for WIC
Persons who market or distribute food, food materials or dietary supplements
Persons who provide weight control services (subject to conditions)
exempt_professions_list.quote: Nothing in this chapter prevents the activities of: Any person licensed or registered in this State under any other law from engaging in the profession or occupation for which that person is licensed or registered; Individuals who give general nutrition-related information; State and federal employees in state or federally funded cooperative extension food and nutrition programs and supplemental food and nutrition programs for women, infants and children; Persons who market or distribute food, food materials or dietary supplements or any person who engages in the explanation of the use of those products or the preparation of those products; and Any person who provides weight control services

federal_employee_exemption.quote: State and federal employees in state or federally funded cooperative extension food and nutrition programs and supplemental food and nutrition programs for women, infants and children

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: Any person who provides weight control services, provided that: A. The weight control program either recommends physician consultation generally or has in place procedures which require physician referral when medical conditions, such as heart disease, cancer, diabetes, hypoglycemia, morbid obesity and pregnancy exist; and B. The program has been reviewed by, consultation is available from and no program change may be initiated without prior approval by: (1) A licensed dietitian

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: Persons who market or distribute food, food materials or dietary supplements or any person who engages in the explanation of the use of those products or the preparation of those products
